auth.secret_policy: Read from environment only; never write token to disk.

form_fields.prompt: Original anime-style female open-world action RPG character named YUNA. Preserve the supplied front identity: silver-white long hair with cyan gradient ends, calm anime face, black white gray sci-fi combat outfit, white stockings, black mechanical boots, translucent mantle, teal resonance core, thin energy sword. Generate a clean editable DCC base mesh for Blender and Unity. Keep character feminine, elegant, high-fidelity, non-realistic anime style. Avoid robot face, low-poly dummy, faceless mannequin, bulky armor, western realistic face, and fused weapon geometry.

bbox_condition.reason: Only use if a second attempt needs stronger body proportion constraints. Rodin expects [width_y, height_z, length_x].

geometry_file_format_glb_second_run.reason: Use for a separate WebGL preview task only if FBX cannot be converted cleanly in Blender.

addons_highpack.reason: Extra-cost texture/face-count boost. Do not enable in the first A/B run unless budget is explicitly approved.
